summary: Iteration 135 — Mira earnings anomaly alerts + redesigned onboard modal. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (shape, marathahalli early + whitefield no_baseline, sort order, alert-now returns ok/flagged=0/sent=False, tenant 403 on both endpoints, create+delete tenant via /api/super-admin/tenants{/,/{id}} works). Unit-ish detect_earnings_anomalies(campaign with start_date 2026-08-01) returns marathahalli flag='ok', drop_pct=0, baseline_monthly=89915 — expected non-'early'. Frontend: /super-admin?tab=tenants shows data-testid=earnings-watch with toggle text 'Mira earnings watch · all clear'; on toggle, anomaly-row-miracurl-marathahalli renders flag 'Too early' and anomaly-row-miracurl-whitefield renders 'No baseline'; clicking anomaly-bills opens settlement-earnings-modal with earnings-total ₹2,950 ✓. Alert-now click surfaces 'Nothing to flag — all salons look healthy' toast ✓. Onboard modal — restaurant toggle changes heading to 'Onboard a New Restaurant' and field label to 'RESTAURANT NAME *'; salon toggle restores. Slug input lowercases + strips: 'Test Salon!!' -> 'testsalon' ✓. Plan Pro selects, save creates tenant and shows one-time password panel/toast (body text confirmed). onboard-cancel / onboard-close close the modal (test partially blocked by credentials modal overlay after save, but earlier pytest cleanup confirms delete endpoint works: DELETE /api/super-admin/tenants/{id} -> 200).

ui_bugs.issue: Modal does not close on Escape key; only via close (X) button. Minor UX polish; blocks click-through to earnings-watch-alert-now if left open.

action_items: Optional: make settlement-earnings-modal close on Escape / backdrop click for parity with other modals.
critical_code_review_comments: detect_earnings_anomalies: baseline computed over 3 months but 'baseline_monthly = baseline_total / 3' hardcodes divisor — if a tenant was created <3 months ago its baseline is diluted (e.g. 2 months of data /3). Consider dividing by number of months actually present or falling back to 'no_baseline'.
sa_anomalies flagged count excludes 'early' and 'no_baseline' by design (only silent+drop). Good; matches the alert email logic.
OnboardTenantModal is well-structured with data-testids; overlay onClick=onClose could conflict with unsaved data — consider confirmation.
Send_anomaly_alert dedupes per ISO week via system_flags — force=True endpoint correctly bypasses. Good.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted qa-anom-* tenants via API (soft-deleted -> status=cancelled). UI-created qa-polish-1788788079 not present in tenants list post-save; may have been silently dropped or listed under a different endpoint — please verify.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both anomalies endpoint and onboard modal behave per spec. Escape-to-close on settlement-earnings-modal is a small polish. UI onboard test created slug qa-polish-1788788079 but it did not show up in GET /api/super-admin/tenants; save flow appeared to succeed (one-time-password body content rendered). Worth verifying whether the SuperAdmin.jsx save handler filters cancelled/inactive tenants from the list or if the create actually failed at the last moment.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Alert-now returns flagged=0 correctly because on today's date (2026-09-07) the campaign is only 2 days old for marathahalli (flag='early') and whitefield has 'no_baseline' — neither counts toward flagged.
